sections.title: Class planning
items: The exercise list is in alphabetical order.
New A–Z | By category switch groups the exercises under their category, with a count for each. The board remembers your choice.

sections.title: Exercise library
items: The gym's library of about 380 exercises can be imported in one step, grouped into 8 categories (Mobility, Warm-up, Boxing school, Sparring and more). Exercises the gym already has are skipped.

sections.title: Fighter styles
items: Nine new artworks to pick for fighter classes, the same size as the existing ones.

sections.title: Student profile
items: "Weaknesses" is now called "Technical adjustments".

sections.title: Home page
items: New home page with the features for coaches and students, and a Log in button that leads to the login.
The login now lives at /login, with a link back to the home page.

sections.title: Languages
items: The app is available in English and Portuguese.
By default it uses the browser's language. If that isn't supported, it uses the server's default language (DEFAULT_LANGUAGE variable, English when not set).
Any user can pick the language in My profile, and the choice follows them to every device.
The home and login pages have an EN | PT switch.

sections.title: Look and feel
items: The heading font now ships with the app, so headings look the same everywhere and fit on phone screens.

sections.title: Project
items: The author's name in the footer links to their GitHub.
New README with screenshots, and an MIT license.

sections.title: Fighter style
items: Besides the main style, the coach can pick a secondary style (e.g. main Out-Boxer, secondary Counterpuncher).
The secondary style shows on the student profile, in My stats and on the Planning board.

sections.title: Focuses
items: Focuses are now free text that only the coach writes, on the student profile or in the Students' week. Students read it but can't edit it.
The focus options in Settings were removed. Each student's focuses from their latest week became the starting text.

sections.title: Student stats
items: Rating guide on the rating screen: 1–2 beginner, 3–4 basic, 5–6 good, 7–8 strong and 9–10 competition level.
Students see the level of each score in My stats.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Deleting an item (such as a stat) and adding it again with the same name no longer fails with "An item with this name already exists": the item comes back.

sections.title: Ranking
items: Missions were removed, including the Missions tab. The ranking now counts class attendance only.
Students see their own fighter class on the ranking page.

sections.title: Planning
items: Exercise cards show each exercise's category.

sections.title: Student stats
items: Monthly assessments became "Student stats": the coach updates each skill's current value whenever they want, without picking a month.
New default skills: Fight IQ, Adaptation and Evasion.

sections.title: Student profile
items: Student level, from Beginner to Advanced, in five steps.
Fighter style on the profile.
Free-text Strengths and Weaknesses lists, which also work for homework and weekly goals.
Students see their level, style, strengths and weaknesses in My stats.

sections.title: Phones
items: Students navigate with a tab bar at the bottom of the screen and a one-line header.
On the student calendar, upcoming classes come first, with clearer cards.
Bigger buttons and tidier ranking and notification screens.

sections.title: General
items: The app version shows in the login footer and on the profile. Click it to see these notes.

sections.title: First version
items: Coach board with class planning, exercises and attendance.
Class calendar, check-in and ranking for students.
Fighter classes, assessments and user profiles.
Multiple gyms, each with its own coaches, students and color.
